row.evidence: Demandbase's SSO guide says "Demandbase does not support Just-In-Time Provisioning. For new users, create the user in Demandbase One first", and no SCIM endpoint or IdP provisioning app is documented anywhere in its help centre or developer docs.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only pricing: the pricing page is a quote form (platform fee plus a flat fee per user, no published prices). Demandbase One supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID SSO (self-service SAML setup for tenants created from 20 Jan 2026, otherwise via Support), but there is no SCIM and no JIT: users must be created in Demandbase first (UI, bulk add, or the Admin API). The Admin API (https://uapi.demandbase.com/admin/v1, bearer JWT from an API key set, 8-hour tokens, 90 requests/min per method) can create, update, list, get and delete users and set permission sets; no IdP connector uses it. Deleting a user is permanent; their lists, filters and reports are kept. No Okta OIN or Microsoft Entra gallery app found. Status none by absence (help-centre search for 'scim' returns 0 articles).

plans.name: Demandbase One (quote-only)
plans.price_text: Custom quote: platform fee plus a flat fee per user

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented; the SSO guide says new users must be created in Demandbase first (no JIT).

auth.notes: API key set (Client ID + Client Secret) exchanged for a JWT bearer token valid 8 hours; key sets choose which APIs (Admin, B2B, Data Export, Data Import) they can call.

capabilities.notes: assign_roles = permission sets in the user payload.

endpoints.purpose: Get a user by external id
Delete user using external user id

rate_limits.text: Admin API: 90 requests per minute per HTTP method; HTTP 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: B2B and Data Export APIs must be enabled by the Demandbase account team before a key set can use them.

okta.notes: OIN search for "demandbase" returns no results; okta.com/integrations/demandbase/ is 404. Demandbase says SSO works with Okta via a custom SAML/OIDC app.

entra.notes: learn.microsoft.com saas-apps demandbase-tutorial and demandbase-provisioning-tutorial return 404.

fallbacks.notes: Users can be added in bulk in the UI; the page does not say whether this is a CSV upload.

searched: https://support.demandbase.com/hc/sitemap.xml (774 URLs: SSO, user management, API articles; nothing on SCIM)
help-centre search API: scim (0 results), provisioning, single sign-on, okta, deactivate
https://developer.demandbase.com/llms.txt (Admin API reference: users only, no SCIM)
open_questions: Pricing is quote-only, so which Demandbase packages include SSO and Admin API access is not stated.
No audit-log API or user-event webhooks are documented.
